title: Rabbi Yishmael ben Luga
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Yoma 38a: Rabbi Akiva said: Rabbi Yishmael ben Luga related to me: Once I went out, I and one of their grandchildren (of those who compounded the incense in the Temple), etc. And in the Jerusalem Talmud, Shekalim ch. 5, halakha 2, they read "Shimon ben Luga," and in Yoma ch. 3, halakha 9, "Shimon ben Lagas."

notes.text: The Bavli narrator Yishmael is Shimon in the two Jerusalem Talmud citations; Luga and Lagas also differ. The parenthesis about the incense preparers is Hyman’s.
